question: Can a spot-first base layer plus perp-only incremental leverage overlay, explicit cash collateral reserve, and deterministic funding-aware overlay reduction realize a safely sustainable leverage sweet spot around the economically attractive 1.20 region while preserving the frozen BRRK-0011 signal/defensive layer and all hard survival, tail-risk, cost, liquidation and robustness constraints?

research_integrity.prior_result_role: motivates the new implementation hypothesis and focal region only; it does not preselect a winner in LEVERAGE-0041

frozen_strategy_layer.rule: Do not change BRRK relative targets, HMM/regime features, semantic states, defensive-scale formula, P3.3 rebalance semantics or P3.4 contribution handling.

economic_exposure_rule.formula: frozen BRRK directional weights × frozen defensive_scale × requested_leverage_cap = requested economic target
economic_exposure_rule.risk_off_monotonicity: For a fixed requested cap, lowering frozen defensive_scale may never increase requested or implemented gross exposure.
economic_exposure_rule.cap_1_target_parity: Before any >1 result is valid, requested economic targets at cap 1.00 must be byte/digest-identical to the frozen BRRK-0011 <=1 target path. Implementation PnL need not equal LEVERAGE-0040 because LEVERAGE-0041 intentionally changes routing/collateral architecture.

implementation_architecture.name: SPOT_FIRST_BASE_PLUS_PERP_OVERLAY_V1

base_long_routing.BTC: P2.4 verified spot-first when identity/capacity/cost evidence permits; residual exposure after the spot cash budget is perp
base_long_routing.ETH: P2.4 verified spot-first when identity/capacity/cost evidence permits; residual exposure after the spot cash budget is perp
base_long_routing.SOL: P2.4 verified spot-first when identity/capacity/cost evidence permits; residual exposure after the spot cash budget is perp

implementation_architecture.short_routing: Any short economic exposure remains perp-only; this experiment does not add or optimize a new short strategy.
implementation_architecture.spot_cash_budget_rule: At each legal daily rebalance, no more than 75 percent of current NAV may be committed to spot positions. Eligible positive BTC/ETH/SOL base-long exposure is allocated to spot up to that budget using the frozen economic target proportions; any residual base-long notional is implemented with perp.
implementation_architecture.incremental_overlay_rule: Economic gross exposure above the cap=1.00 target is perp-only. Overlay may only scale the frozen requested target; it may not alter cross-asset relative weights or defensive-state semantics.
implementation_architecture.collateral_rule: The reserved 25 percent NAV is modeled as explicit USDC-like cross-margin collateral and cannot be simultaneously counted as spot financing. If routed perp positions plus mandatory stresses are unsafe under the actual modeled account state, the candidate fails or is reduced only by the frozen funding/risk reducers; no hidden external collateral is assumed.

funding_aware_overlay_reducer.role: implementation-risk reducer only; never alpha, direction selection or a reason to increase exposure
funding_aware_overlay_reducer.native_source: Hyperliquid completed hourly fundingHistory normalized under the frozen P3.1/P4.4 data semantics
funding_aware_overlay_reducer.metric: trailing 168h realized funding debit divided by average absolute routed perp notional, converted to bps/day; favorable credits are clamped to zero for the reducer
funding_aware_overlay_reducer.scale_rule: overlay_funding_scale = 1 when debit<=5 bps/day; = (10-debit)/5 for 5<debit<10; =0 when debit>=10. Missing required funding data fails closed to overlay_funding_scale=0.
funding_aware_overlay_reducer.monotonicity: The reducer may only preserve or reduce the incremental overlay. It may never raise gross exposure above the requested cap.

focal_point_rule: 1.20 receives no favorable selection treatment. It is only the center of the preregistered neighborhood.
search_above_1_30_rule: Requires a new experiment ID and preregistration before execution.

tail_risk.rule: The frozen defensive 20 percent scenario CVaR/CDaR gate is unchanged and may not be weakened by the new implementation architecture.

objective.primary: maximize matched after-cost long-run compounded terminal wealth / CAGR among candidates that pass every hard gate

mandatory_benchmarks.description: BTC buy-and-hold on the matched evaluation window
BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB equal-weight buy-and-hold on the matched evaluation window
Immutable LEVERAGE-0040 cap=1.00 comparator, reported without reinterpretation

transaction_cost_treatment.rule: Spot/perp routes use P2.3/P2.4 itemized execution economics. Candidate and comparator costs must use matched conventions; VWAP/slippage and generic bps costs may not be double-counted.

funding_treatment.native_rule: Charge native Hyperliquid funding only to actual routed perp notional. Do not charge spot notional perp funding.
funding_treatment.stress_rule: Funding-spike stress multiplies debit magnitude only; favorable credits are never enlarged.
funding_treatment.missing_data_rule: Missing required native funding evidence blocks promotion.

synthetic_market_stress.execution_rule: No favorable same-day rebalance, funding response or collateral transfer is assumed inside a one-day gap shock.

scenarios.name: PARTIAL_FILL_50_PCT
scenarios.unfilled_remainder_rule: remain at prior exposure until next legal decision; do not assume favorable immediate completion

degraded_fill_stress.capacity_rule: Unsupported stressed notional fails the implementation scenario instead of assuming a fill.

liquidation_distance.account_mapping_change: Evaluate only actual routed perp notionals against the explicit 25 percent cash collateral reserve; spot notional is not misclassified as perp notional or silently treated as extra cross-margin collateral.
liquidation_distance.acceptance: No modeled liquidation in mandatory historical or synthetic stress. Minimum adverse-move distance to modeled liquidation must exceed the largest applicable preregistered one-day gap stress (50 percent uniform) plus a 5 percentage-point buffer, i.e. >55 percent, for every promotable candidate state.

robustness.broad_region_rule: A selected cap must belong to a contiguous region of at least three requested caps that all pass every hard gate. The selected cap itself must have both an immediate lower and immediate higher passing neighbor; therefore a boundary cap cannot be selected as the sweet spot.
robustness.near_tie_rule: If multiple passing caps in the same qualifying region are within 1.0 percentage point of annualized CAGR, choose the lower cap.

selection_rule: Among caps inside a qualifying contiguous passing region, select the highest matched after-cost CAGR subject to all hard gates. Apply the near-tie lower-cap rule. Do not select a cap merely because it is 1.20 or because it maximized LEVERAGE-0040 historical CAGR.
promotion_success_conditions: cap=1.00 requested economic target path exactly reproduces frozen BRRK-0011 <=1 targets before any >1 result is considered
all four mandatory benchmarks are reported on matched windows
after-cost compounded wealth is strictly higher than frozen BRRK at matched 5 bps and 10 bps cases
candidate is not dominated by frozen BRRK at 20 bps
selected operating drawdown budget is respected
70 percent catastrophe boundary is never breached
frozen 20 percent defensive scenario CVaR/CDaR gate is not weakened
all mandatory historical, synthetic gap/volatility, funding-spike and degraded-fill scenarios pass
liquidation-distance >55 percent evidence passes and missing venue evidence fails closed
start-date and stationary-block robustness thresholds pass
candidate belongs to a contiguous all-pass region of at least three caps and has passing immediate lower and higher neighbors
candidate uses no new directional alpha, XRP target, EXPOSURE-SMOOTH-0038 substitution, P5 exit logic or production-only assumption

prospective_deployment_cap_rule.rule_if_research_promoted: The prospective live cap presented to P4.6 is the next lower preregistered cap grid point than the selected research cap and may never exceed 1.20 under LEVERAGE-0041.
prospective_deployment_cap_rule.authorization: P4.6 remains a separate explicit production decision; LEVERAGE-0041 cannot authorize production leverage.

stopping_rule: Run the frozen LEVERAGE-0041 candidate/cost/funding/stress/liquidation/robustness suite once after implementation contract, target-path parity and input-evidence gates are green. Do not retune after any candidate result is observed. Material changes require a new experiment ID.

run_authority.rule: Committing or merging this preregistration does not authorize the one-time study run. A separately explicit owner RUN_ONCE instruction is required after implementation and pre-run gates are green.

forbidden: modify or reinterpret LEVERAGE-0040 immutable result
change BRRK-0011 relative targets, HMM/regime features or defensive-scale formula
extend the frozen defensive selector above 1.0
change the frozen 20 percent scenario CVaR/CDaR budget or 70 percent catastrophe limit to obtain a pass
change the 1.00-1.30 candidate grid after any LEVERAGE-0041 result is observed
optimize the 5/10 bps-per-day funding reducer thresholds after seeing results
treat funding as alpha or allow funding logic to increase exposure
assume spot collateral or external collateral not explicitly represented by the architecture
add new shorts, XRP target exposure or P5 exit intelligence
overwrite historical BRRK or LEVERAGE-0040 artifacts
authorize production leverage or production trading
required_result_artifacts: route split table: spot / base-perp / incremental-perp / cash reserve
effective realized gross after funding reducer
frozen BRRK baseline and immutable LEVERAGE-0040 cap1 comparator
native funding plus funding-reducer and funding-spike panels
liquidation-distance table using actual routed perp notionals and explicit collateral reserve
selection/failure decision with no post-result retuning

hypotheses.H1: At least one interior cap in the preregistered 1.05-1.25 region belongs to a contiguous three-cap all-pass neighborhood and improves matched after-cost compounded wealth versus frozen BRRK while satisfying every hard gate under the new implementation architecture.
hypotheses.H0: No requested cap above 1.0 satisfies the complete LEVERAGE-0041 gate; preserve production gross cap 1.0 and do not proceed to P4.6 leverage authorization.
